blockers.description: The radius re-derivation invalidates an unknown share of the 388 tracked Playwright visual baselines in visual/__screenshots__/. The sanctioned regeneration workflow (.github/workflows/visual-baselines.yml) is hard-gated to `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`, so it CANNOT be dispatched for this change while it lives on the phase branch. CI's `visual` job will therefore go red on the phase branch, and CLAUDE.md makes a red job a hard blocker on advancing.
blockers.workaround: Undecided — needs a user call. Option A: record locally with `CI=1 pnpm exec playwright test --project visual --update-snapshots=all` and commit (playwright.config.ts's ignoreSnapshots:!CI means CI=1 is mandatory or it silently no-ops; ADR tech/0008 deliberately discourages off-CI baseline writes, though its stated concern is Windows renderers and this box is Linux like the runner). Option B: accept the visual job red on the phase branch and regenerate via the sanctioned workflow after the phase merges to main. A diagnostic `CI=1 playwright test --project visual` run (compare only, no writes) was about to be started when the session was paused — it would have measured how many baselines actually differ AND whether this box's renderer matches CI at all (if untouched components like switch/checkbox also differ, Option A is off the table).
